workload: Guardian Heroes Resume; title BGM client 2; MacBook Air speakers at 48 kHz stereo.
acceptance_scope: Basic audible title audio and F9 restore, confirmed by the user.
method: Callback averages are weighted by invocation count. Each endpoint chunk contains 256 samples at 48000 Hz. The dense-build startup window ends from 4 seconds inclusive to 34 seconds exclusive after client 2 registration; no profiler runs inside this window.

release_restore_credit_fix.behavior: Every consumed restored endpoint frame returns its scheduler credit in Release builds. The FrameConsumed call executes outside the assertion.

continuation_pc_membership.behavior: Fully contiguous 4-byte PC sets use range and alignment checks; sparse sets retain binary search. Current, Next, call and return PC validation, step budgets and snapshot semantics remain enforced.

callback_duration_semantics: The measured wall time includes the guest producer wait: 0x82651940 unwraps the argument and enters 0x82651770, which signals the request event, waits on two guest objects (WaitAny), and transposes/submits 256x6 samples only when object 1 is signaled. It is not a measurement of local PCM mixing cost.
comparison_limits: The credit-fix baseline is a post-F9 title window and the dense result is a startup title window; they are separate runs and not the same snapshot.
User acceptance covers basic audible audio and F9; long play and full-game coverage remain open.
conclusion: Basic audio and F9 are accepted by the user. The dense PC path supplies the measured title audio within the 5.333 ms frame budget on average; its clean startup window contains 7 silence chunks among 5640 output chunks.
